raw:
The 2001 Canadian Grand Prix (round 8, Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, 10 June 2001) was won by Ralf Schumacher driving for Williams. He started 2nd. His teammate-rival Michael Schumacher of Ferrari, who started from pole, finished 2nd, and Mika Häkkinen was 3rd.

ANSWER: Ralf Schumacher
